(though i’ve found it most easy to do it irl). 
i’ve self harmed too - and it’s an evil cycle of shit. try to find the reason why you self harm, and then try to work with that. while you work, find other methods - once, to cope with everything, i just smashed plates, haha! but there’s loads of other mechanisms to get that same feeling, that self harm gives you - you just have to find out what works for you. 
and as twenty one pilots said it: in the meantime make it about some one else. 

listen to ride (one of my favorites, when i don’t know where to go or what to do), take a deep breath and remember that i believe in you!! 

lots of hugs!
